## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`…; `!` for breaking changes)
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] Behaviour changes are covered by a test in `RapidRepo.Testing.Conformance`
- [ ] Docs under `docs/` and XML comments are updated
- [ ] Breaking changes are described in the migration guide
